messages.text: Welcome to the //CodeBreaker War Room! Squad locked in: CodeKeeper (Wesley), CodeJSON (Jei Shun), and CodeZero (Shaw Zhe). Try typing '@ai' in chat, pasting a screenshot (Ctrl+V), or uploading any PDF/image/CSV in the '📎 AI File Scanner' tab!

Moved our //CodeBreaker repo to GitHub (https://github.com/tajeishun-glitch/GermanyConquer)! Make sure CodeKeeper & CodeZero accept collaborator invites under Settings -> Collaborators so all 3 of us can push & merge!
New AI upgrades are live: upload any competition brief, site photo, or CSV in '📎 AI File Scanner' to generate 3 Gamuda ideas automatically, or click '🎤 3-Min Pitch & Judge Score' on any Idea Card!

ideas.title: SiteSense AI — Multimodal Construction Safety & Progress Copilot
ideas.problem: Site engineers spend hours manually reviewing daily site photos, WhatsApp updates, and safety checklists across packages, delaying hazard detection.
ideas.solution: Upload site photos or voice notes to Gemini 3.8 Flash multimodal AI to auto-flag PPE/housekeeping hazards, map them to zone IDs, and draft daily site inspection reports in 10 seconds.
ideas.gamudaImpact: Saves ~1.5 hrs/day per site engineer and surfaces high-risk safety issues before shift handover.

ideas.title: TenderGuard — Instant Contract & BOQ Risk Radar
ideas.problem: Reviewing 500-page tender specs and Bills of Quantities (BOQ) under tight deadlines risks missing non-standard penalty clauses or material spec mismatches.
ideas.solution: Split-screen AI reviewer that compares new tender PDFs against Gamuda historical benchmarks, highlighting high-risk clauses, cost drivers, and ambiguity questions.
ideas.gamudaImpact: Cuts first-pass tender review from 3 days to 30 minutes with traceable page citations.
